prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1218; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Treatment summary for a patient with cervical strain following a sideswipe collision during a lane change. The described mechanism is consistent with the reported symptoms of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Over fifteen visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program. The course ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of strain, reflecting a slower recovery pattern. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury to the cervical region is known, and the available history contains no earlier complaints involving this area. Billing records show a single, appropriate charge for each service, with no repeated entries. The patient has shown steady improvement and has been discharged to home self-management, with follow-up available as needed.
